scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core -w packages/screen -w packages/source -w packages/server
scripts.check: npm run check -w packages/core -w packages/screen -w packages/source -w packages/server
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); for (const p of fs.readdirSync('packages')) fs.rmSync('packages/' + p + '/dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
